title: 一般設定更清楚，操作說明隨需展開
summary: 一般設定改用分組排列，減少重複卡片與長篇文字，讓常用選項更容易找到。
highlights: 基本設定、選取與複製、文字辨識集中分組呈現。
自動複製的操作說明與進階選項可展開查看，關閉功能時收起附屬設定。
剪貼簿覆寫提醒與需要處理的啟動狀態仍直接顯示，原有偏好保持不變。
usage: 開啟 SnapBar 設定的一般頁面；啟用自動複製後，可展開操作說明或進階選項。無額外必要條件。

en.title: Clearer general settings with help on demand
en.summary: Grouped settings reduce visual clutter and lengthy explanations so frequently used options are easier to find.
highlights: Settings are grouped into Basics, Selection and copying, and Text recognition.
Expand How to use and Advanced options for Auto copy; related controls are hidden when the feature is off.
Clipboard replacement and actionable startup status remain visible, with existing preferences preserved.
en.usage: Open General in SnapBar settings. Enable Auto copy to reveal How to use and Advanced options. No additional prerequisites.
